scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,app "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: eslint packages/contracts/src api/src api/scripts app playwright.config.ts tests/e2e gates vitest.config.ts eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings 0
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json packages/contracts api app playwright.config.ts tests/e2e gates
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json packages/contracts api app playwright.config.ts tests/e2e gates
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:ui
